name: opensearch-operations
description: Read-only SRE diagnostics for self-hosted OpenSearch using the configured OpenSearch connection.

interface.longDescription: Diagnose cluster health, shard allocation, node pressure, pending tasks, and hot threads through the built-in HTTP Request tool while selecting an independent OpenSearch connection by name.
defaultPrompt: Check this OpenSearch cluster for operational health issues.
Explain why OpenSearch shards are unassigned.
Check OpenSearch nodes for resource pressure.
